task.description:
Step 1 — Root cause diagnosis for ISS-0717 / GH-816.

Issue summary: VLD-04 AC1 requires that any draft-save of a definition with semantic findings returns HTTP 422. The semantic gate (runSemanticGate) was wired into handlePut (PUT /api/v1/definitions/{id}), but the ACTUAL live route registered in main.zig is PATCH /api/v1/definitions/{id} -> handlePatch. handlePatch does not call runSemanticGate. The frontend (web/src/api/definitions.ts updateDefinition) uses client.patch, so it bypasses the gate.

Your tasks:
1. Read src/main.zig to confirm PATCH /api/v1/definitions/{id} is registered to handlePatch (not handlePut).
2. Read src/api/routes/definitions.zig to confirm handlePatch does NOT call runSemanticGate, and handlePut DOES call it.
3. Read src/design/vld-04-validation-gate-authoring-promotion.md to understand the design intent (was it PUT or PATCH?).
4. Read web/src/api/definitions.ts to confirm updateDefinition uses client.patch.
5. Produce a root cause statement: which file/line is the definitive mismatch, and which fix option from the GH-816 body is most appropriate (Option 1: wire gate into handlePatch, OR Option 2: change frontend to PUT and register handlePut).
6. Recommend one of the two fix options with justification.

Write your diagnosis into docs/issues/ISS-0717.json (update root_cause field) and complete the handoff.

context.issue_title: VLD-04 AC1: live draft-save surface is PATCH (handlePatch), not PUT (handlePut) — frontend draft-save path is not gate-enforced

result.summary: Root cause confirmed (Category A — Logic error). src/main.zig line 717 registers PATCH /api/v1/definitions/{id} -> handlePatch; no .PUT branch exists for definitions. handlePut (definitions.zig line 362) calls runSemanticGate (line 412) but is unreachable — dead code. handlePatch (line 458) calls store.update and returns HTTP 200 with no gate check. web/src/api/definitions.ts line 29 uses client.patch, confirming the live frontend draft-save path bypasses VLD-04 AC1. Design doc named PUT as the call site but the PUT route was never registered. Recommended fix: Option 1 — wire runSemanticGate into handlePatch (single-file change to src/api/routes/definitions.zig; no changes to main.zig or frontend required).
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (WF-03 Step 2): wire runSemanticGate into handlePatch in src/api/routes/definitions.zig, then route to TEST-RUNNER (WF-03 Step 3)
